finding.text: The ask (diagnose the two failing tests, fix at the cause, prove all five pass) is met: tests/session.jsonl has the cause with FAIL text and commits, the proof lines and commit 3b016ecba5c7; the diff is two test-only edits (anchor.mjs:34, stall.mjs:114) with no weakened assertion.

anchor.mjs:34 now hides a real UI behaviour: if the live wire errors, the sheet's "Servex link down" banner shifts the thread 52 px after 8 s. That is intended banner behaviour, but no test asserts the banner itself or that its shift is acceptable; the comment records the reason, which is enough for this task.

ux/Dictate/readme.md:9 lists the proofs but omits `test/anchor.mjs`, `order.mjs` and `flicker.mjs`, which the brief names as proofs; add them (and `doc/debug-tab.md:85` lists stall.mjs scenarios `[hang|refuse|whisper|reload]` without `late`, which this change touches), so a fresh agent finds every test.

The log says why stall "late" passed before is unproven, then gives the `connecting` state explanation (e5c20130c) in the next line; the resulting test now stops only after a sentence is said, which is sound. A fresh agent can continue from tests/session.jsonl alone.
